children: European Central Bank board member Isabel Schnabel will leave the bank early to take on a senior role at the International Monetary Fund, with an announcement imminent and possibly later on Thursday, two sources familiar with the matter told Reuters.

The eight-year term of Schnabel, the head of the ECB's market operations, was set to last until the end of 2027 but the IMF was keen to find a new director of its market department by the close of this year, the sources said.
The ECB and the IMF both declined to comment.
